test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The bar graph below shows the sale of books (in thousand) has been given in two consecutive years of 2010 and 2011 of five branches of a publishing company. Find the ratio of total sales in the two years of branch C2 to the total sales in both years of branch C4?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b05ccd2362eb5a0071521d592de9f3d02950664ad0ba044ff90e13a275e1080.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total sales of C2 for two years:

79 + 91 = 170

Total sales of C4 for two years:

66 + 86 = 152

The ratio will be:

170 : 152

85 : 76

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
